description: This file defines a feature for deleting a follower relationship within a social media-like application. It includes a command class, a validator, and a request handler that processes the deletion logic by interacting with the database context and profile reading services.

classes.name: Delete.Command
classes.description: Represents the command to delete a follower, containing the username of the person to unfollow.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates the command, ensuring the username is not null or empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the deletion process by interacting with the database context, verifying users, removing the follow relationship, and returning the updated profile.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the follower deletion logic asynchronously, including validation, removal, and profile retrieval.
